provider: Arweave via Turbo / ar.io free tier

free_tier.stated: Free tier: 105 KiB per data item, and only 10 MiB over the lifetime of a wallet AND 10 MiB over the lifetime of an IP range. Anything larger is billed in Turbo credits.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

retention.stated: | Data is permanent once paid, but the free path is metered by IP range so a datacenter host fails at upload time with 402 regardless of wallet balance.

egress.terms: Free and permanent by design (Arweave pays storage endowment up front; gateways serve reads without metering).

chaining: The 10 MiB wallet cap is the point: unlimited wallets x 10 MiB = still trivial, and the per-IP-range cap blocks the obvious Sybil route from one host. 20 TiB would need ~2 million wallets x 10 MiB.
limits_note: 105 KiB/file; 10 MiB/wallet; 10 MiB/IP-range; HTTP 402 over the cap; wallet signing required per item.
